objective: Repair PR #12 at exact starting head 8b34a247161d671678520f695fc0fc8e3fcef15d by making normalization publication interruption-safe with receipt-as-commit-marker semantics, enforcing all source/evidence/publication cross-bindings in the existing two Pydantic contracts, and deriving archive fingerprints from actual read-only source objects.
acceptance_criteria: Publish content object, normalization snapshot, and normalization receipt in that exact order, with the receipt as the sole authoritative commit marker.
Recover exact object-only, object-plus-snapshot, complete, and complete-plus-stale-own-stage states without replacing correct bytes.
Use one deterministic bundle-bound stage; preserve unrelated incoming content and mismatched evidence.
Reject mismatched object, snapshot, receipt, stage, receipt-without-snapshot, receipt-without-object, and changed-bundle states without replacement.
Enforce all six source/evidence, object, package, font-role, MorphGNT span, target-token, receipt-path, and unique-identity cross-bindings during model validation.
Regenerate only the two existing schemas and registry hashes; add no public contract or dependency.
Read, hash, measure, and verify read-only every referenced source object during each authority fingerprint.
Pass the complete quality, coverage, integrity, and DR-30 gates.
Freeze implementation before two real canonical-archive dry runs and prove identical bundle output and actual-object fingerprints with zero writes.
